page.notes: Uncertain readings: the Greek words φύσι, θέσι and χρήσι are read from a small scan and may carry a final ει; marked [?]. "libertatem" is printed with a faint mark between "libert" and "tem" and may be damaged. The line-end "quendi" after "lo-" is partly cut at the margin of the scan, so "quendi" is inferred. The final word is cut off by the page edge, as "asti-" continues onto the next page. The black letter words (fatth, truth, troth) are set in Gothic type inside roman text. The margin note reads "Horat.de" and "art.poet." on two lines, joined here.
